regime_context: US thematic leadership is concentrated in a coherent AI-infrastructure complex (AI Infra, WFE, Memory/HBM, Cybersecurity, AI Semis all eligible and highly ranked). The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control on this market (gate_helps=true), so eligible-leg strength is a useful staying-power filter; cross-sectional rank itself is a focus lens only, and rotation timing has no forward edge.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Semiconductor Equipment (WFE) closes the leader gap: it is the top challenger (score 1.698 vs leader 2.253, margin 0.555), eligible and high durability_bar 0.8, but crowded=true (z 1.01) — a CONFIRMED handoff (WFE score overtaking AI Infra while WFE breadth stays >0.85 and crowding_z cools below 0.8) would retire this watch.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Leader with highest score and strong breadth (0.875). The absolute-trend gate leg is the only validated edge and it is eligible and above the durability bar (0.73>implied threshold), so it survives the drawdown-avoidance filter. Crowding is not flagged (z 0.81, crowded=false), so no sizing caution triggers. A low-conviction overweight expresses the prevailing leadership without extracting a return forecast from the rank.
theses.dissent: AI Infrastructure's rank is attention-driven (rank-IC ~0), and a fading val_state with a mixed Hurst tag suggests the leadership may be late-cycle rather than early; past record (dir_accuracy 0.488) argues against strong directional confidence.

falsifier.text: SMH falls below its own 50-day average and AI Infrastructure breadth drops below 0.60 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Highest durability_bar (0.81) in the top tier and perfect breadth (1.0), held as eligible with a trend Hurst tag. Strong cohesion supports the trend-gate leg. Crowding IS flagged (z 1.91, crowded=true), so the guardrail directs a size-down, not a fade — the lean stays overweight but the conviction is capped at low.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.91 is the highest in the eligible set; guardrails warn crowding marks attention peaks, not forward returns, and a crowded trend-gated name has no demonstrated edge beyond drawdown control.

falsifier.text: CIBR breadth falls below 0.70 while its crowding_z stays above 1.5 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Fails the ONLY validated leg: eligible=false, durability_bar 0.13, hurst_tag mean-revert, breadth 0.125. The absolute-trend gate is the one demonstrated edge and this theme is on the wrong side of it. Avoid is the trend-gate-consistent stance, not a fade call.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting miners can snap back violently on a precious-metals bid; avoiding is a staying-power call, not a return forecast, and the theme may outperform without the gate.

falsifier.text: SIL clears its eligibility gate (absolute-trend above threshold) with breadth above 0.5 before the check-by date
